veranderings.voor: Hulle was vroeg en die klok
veranderings.na: Hulle was vroeg, en die klok
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.na: Juffrou Mans Thandi se naam netjies
veranderings.rede: 'haar' straight after 'Juffrou Mans' can be read as the teacher's own name; naming Thandi removes the ambiguity.

veranderings.voor: Sy naam was Sipho en hy
veranderings.na: Sy naam was Sipho, en hy
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: en syne het spinasie en wortels in.
veranderings.na: en in sy klas s'n groei spinasie en wortels.
veranderings.rede: 'syne het ... in' is loose and colloquial, and 'syne' reads as Sipho's own bed rather than his class's.

veranderings.na: nie een keer in die rede geval nie
veranderings.rede: The idiom is 'in die rede val'; 'ingeval' on its own reads as the conjunction 'in case'.

veranderings.voor: werk Thandi se ma laat en Thandi
veranderings.na: werk Thandi se ma laat, en Thandi
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: of Thandi ná skool sy bedding kom kyk
veranderings.na: of Thandi ná skool sy bedding wil kom kyk
veranderings.rede: Reported invitation needs 'wil' to read naturally as a question about her wish.

veranderings.voor: Sipho se ouma het hulle daarna tot by Tant Rosa se hek gestap.
veranderings.na: Sipho se ouma het daarna saam met hulle tot by Tant Rosa se hek gestap.
veranderings.rede: Transitive 'iemand stap' copies English 'walked them'; Afrikaans says 'saam met hulle gestap'.
Reading names out to a class is 'voorlees'; 'gelees' suggests she read them to herself.
Applause is 'hande klap'; 'geklap' alone can mean slapped or banged.

veranderings.voor: in die pouse vir almal by die trap van die koor vertel
veranderings.na: in die pouse by die trap vir almal van die koor vertel
veranderings.rede: As written 'die trap van die koor' reads as the choir's steps; moving the place phrase forward fixes the attachment.

vlae.rede: AWS writes a title before a name in lower case ('juffrou Mans', 'tant Rosa'); it recurs ten times, so I did not propose each change separately. A person should decide whether house style keeps the capitals.
